# Operation setup

How an Operation is assembled from stock parts and registered: its packs, its identity, its deployment phase and its menu entry.

Topic `operation-setup`, declared by ops. Back to [the map](../README.md).

## Mechanisms

### PLAYED

- [content-identity-unique](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/content-identity-unique.md): Two mods cloned from one template must not share an identity (ops, verified 201602)
- [custom-operation-from-stock-parts](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/custom-operation-from-stock-parts.md): A custom Operation can be built entirely from cloned stock files plus a generated LevelDesign and GDScript (ops, verified 201602)
- [deployment-phase-recipe](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/deployment-phase-recipe.md): A deployment phase needs six parts, and buying after the launch needs player arrival entries (ops, verified 201602)
- [gameplay-mod-relaunch](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/gameplay-mod-relaunch.md): Operations and Gameplay mods don't mix; an Operation mod must ship none of the 16 Gameplay files (ops, verified 201602)
- [operation-menu-registration](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/operation-menu-registration.md): A new scenario id in a mod's Scenarios folder is listed and launches; a stock name is not overridden (ops, verified 201602)

### PROBED

- [soviet-player-camp](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/soviet-player-camp.md): A clone of Survivors loads and plays with a Soviet player in the stock PACT-player camp shape (ops, verified 201602)

### STOCK

- [scripted-economy](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/scripted-economy.md): A script sets the player's points, a zero income, one-time grants and a later income in stock's own nodes (ops, verified 201602)

## Lessons

Taught by the trials of these mechanisms.

- [check-against-every-active-mod](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/check-against-every-active-mod.md) (core): A build's gates see that build alone; check what must stay unique across every mod active beside it
- [counting-parts-is-not-checking](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/counting-parts-is-not-checking.md) (ops): Counting the parts of a recipe is not checking them
- [debrief-by-what-the-map-shows](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/debrief-by-what-the-map-shows.md) (core): Design probe results to show on the map, and debrief with a few multiple-choice questions about what was seen
- [decide-zones-by-count](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/decide-zones-by-count.md) (ops): Decide zone rules by timed counts and force the owner; keep real captures for flavour
- [derive-cross-mod-ids-from-a-hash](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/derive-cross-mod-ids-from-a-hash.md) (core): A value that must be unique across every mod a player runs comes from a hash, never a hand pick
- [fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch.md) (core): After a failed launch, find the root cause, gate it, fix, reinstall hash-checked, and update the play sheet
- [no-stock-precedent-is-untested](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/no-stock-precedent-is-untested.md) (ops): No stock script does it means untested, whatever the API allows
- [one-stall-hides-the-rest](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/one-stall-hides-the-rest.md) (core): Put each probe beat in its own parallel branch, so one stall cannot hide the rest
- [recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate.md) (core): A recipe recorded in research must become a gate, or the next generator drops part of it
- [stock-deck-fits-its-own-mission](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/stock-deck-fits-its-own-mission.md) (ops): A stock deck is shaped for its own mission; check it holds what your op needs, where your op shows it
- [test-the-theory-against-every-observation](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/test-the-theory-against-every-observation.md) (core): Before handing over a fix from analysis, test it against every observation, the build that worked included
